harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Established BRANCH.TEST on node1 and configured node2 for the legacy reports service. Analyst can obtain the service ticket, `/etc/krb5.keytab` validates it, both nodes passed sequential reboot persistence tests, and the ownership notes remain byte-for-byte intact.
actions_performed: Installed the signed CentOS 5-compatible krb5-server 1.6.1-78 package without changing the OS release or kernel.
Configured BRANCH.TEST realm resolution on both nodes and enabled persistent KDC services/firewall access on node1.
Installed the root-only application keytab at /etc/krb5.keytab on node2 and a root-only analyst test credential.
Verified analyst TGT acquisition, service-ticket issuance, and keytab validation.
Restarted node1 and node2 sequentially and verified changed boot identities and complete recovery.
Confirmed the ownership-note checksums, permissions, sizes, and timestamps were preserved.

evidence.requirement: BRANCH.TEST realm and required principals on node1
evidence.summary: Shows principal creation, running/enabled KDC services, and final principal presence.

evidence.requirement: Application keytab on node2 and successful analyst-to-service flow
evidence.summary: Shows the exact service principal in the root-only keytab, ticket issuance at kvno 3, and `keytab entry valid` before and after restart.
Original and final checksums match: principals.tsv c88b92c676e01bbc1ddc60b82981de1c and realm-notes.txt c9d0e15a6600747e7646584702acedd7.

evidence.requirement: Legacy operating-system release and kernel retained
evidence.summary: Both nodes remain CentOS 5.11 with kernel 2.6.18-398.el5 and matching Kerberos 1.6.1-78 packages.

Healthy baseline boot ID f412fa38-65cb-408b-8000-000000000000, restart acknowledgment, changed boot ID b19fcdfd-0b6f-459a-8000-000000000000, recovered services/principals, and successful cross-node ticket validation.

Healthy baseline boot ID f462fbe1-f6bb-4005-8000-000000000000, restart acknowledgment, changed boot ID 2574aacc-b2a0-45b8-8000-000000000000, persistent keytab, and successful post-restart ticket validation.
